# infrawrench_linear_integration (Resource)

The organization's Linear connection, used to file issues from findings and alerts.

An organization **singleton**. `terraform destroy` disconnects it, which drops the stored key; existing issue links survive.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Personal API key from Linear → Settings → Security & access. **Required on first connect**; omit it afterwards to keep the stored key.

Write-only: no route returns it, so the provider cannot detect drift on its value. Compare `key_hint` if you need to check which key is stored.
- `default_team_id` (String) Team the file-issue window preselects. A Linear team **id**, not a team key like `ENG`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. The Linear connection is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.
- `key_hint` (String) Redacted marker for the stored key, e.g. `…a7f2`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_linear_integration.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
